summary: Comprehensive implementation plan covering: (1) Document Studio inline LaTeX fix, 2-tab word processor ribbon with direct Page Margins, Header/Footer, and Page Numbering controls, click-to-edit headers/footers on the sheet, active-edit preview synchronization, and UI decluttering; (2) CBT Creation Studio zero-lag multi-question architecture for 50-200+ questions with container-width-responsive 1-column/2-column split and full-view grids; (3) Recent Projects & User Guides Landing Hub for both studios; (4) Instant 0ms HTML test rendering in CBTViewer across online/offline and LaTeX/standard font modes; and (5) complete Help Center updates.
